lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five semi-regular horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region. The spots exhibit a vertical alignment that creates a repeating rectangular lattice in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, most notably between the first and third longitudinal ridges, creating distinct nodal points of maximum luminance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, each defined by a high-contrast luminance gradient with light-saturated upper edges and deep shadow on the ventral-facing slopes.

other_distinctive_markers: A single, high-chroma orange/yellow circular mark is visible on the upper left flank, located between the first and second longitudinal ridges.
